description: This PHP source file defines the class GetGroupUsers, which retrieves all users associated with a specific group in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for fetching users from multiple related database tables, including subgroups, roles, and relations, constructing a comprehensive list of users within a group.

classes.name: GetGroupUsers
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving all user IDs belonging to a given group, including direct members, role-based users, subordinate users, and nested group members.

methods.name: getAllUsersInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves and accumulates all user IDs associated with a specified group ID by querying various relational tables and handling nested groups recursively.
